integrity: Exact arithmetic in Z[phi]; all 4845 subsets and all 969 fixed-vertex triples verified by included Python checker; independent external audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite exhaustive classification of tetrahedral volumes for four distinct dodecahedron vertices only; no volume gap for arbitrary inscribed tetrahedra; classical existence of ten regular tetrahedra not novel. Related older numerical catalogues might cover some or all levels.
title: Eleven exact tetrahedral volume levels in the regular dodecahedron
